title: JSON: add auto_hide preference to hide root item automatically
description:
Determine whether to hide the tree of original form or root item of compact or raw form based on the enabled status of `compact_form` and `raw_form` preferences if `auto_hide` is enabled.

If the preference `auto_hide` is disabled, then everything remains the same as before: (The tree in original form and root items of compact or raw displayed)

![json_disable_auto_hide_item_preference](/uploads/febdf50f22777c740922fca70cafdcb1/json_disable_auto_hide_item_preference.png)

If the preference `auto_hide` is enabled and `compact_form` or `raw_form` is enabled, then the tree in original form is hidden:

![json_enable_auto_hide_item_preference1](/uploads/ebf850bd01c267bda53c1076ac309c71/json_enable_auto_hide_item_preference1.png)

If the preference `auto_hide` is enabled and only one of `compact_form` or `raw_form` is enabled, then the tree in original form is hidden and the root item of compact or raw form is also hidden and the content of compact or raw form will be put under the tree item of JSON protocol directly:

![json_enable_auto_hide_item_preference2](/uploads/ccf524d6b0571f6d30ae7614d181ae1f/json_enable_auto_hide_item_preference2.png)
